answer: Random beacon audits and a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent registers one identity with a 40 POA ember deposit, and keeps a public relic: a signed heartbeat log. Each epoch the beacon audits 10% of agents: answer in 60s or the ember burns. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 live processes and 40,000 POA locked against a 3,000 POA pool — a sure loss. An honest agent pays one deposit and one heartbeat per epoch, its share undiluted.
